name: Chocolat
source: An A-rank adventurer and dark elf, Chocolat is a master of magic. She meets Van when he registers for the guild, and asks to form a party to aid in her search for a cursed item. Chocolat is not just knowledgeable, but her honest and rash thinking often lands her in hot water.
